_doc: SLOT CADENCE ROSTER — ONE SOURCE OF TRUTH (work order W3, 2026-08-28). Every accountability consumer reads a component's cadence from HERE and never hardcodes 'daily'. The class this ends: a component moved to weekly, and every checker that assumed daily started reporting it dead — so the alarms became noise on exactly the days they should have been trusted.

_fields.dow: for weekly: the day it runs (0=Sun … 6=Sat)
_fields.source: measured = derived from the boards · declared = stated by the owner and not yet observable here · contested = two readings disagree, entry set to whichever KEEPS THE ALARM ON · owner-observed = the owner read the app scheduler directly, which no session can do — outranks a board inference
_fields.falsifier: what would prove this entry wrong. An entry with no falsifier is a belief, not a record.

daily-improvement.evidence: OWNER CONFIRMED 2026-08-28 ~10:00 ET: both scheduler cards read WEEKLY in the app — the one reading no session can take. This resolves the 08-28 contest: the 08-26 cadence order took effect; the 08-27/28 silence was correct weekly behaviour, and the health-check DEAD verdict was the roster-lag false alarm this file exists to end. Prior daily history: ran daily through 08-26.
daily-improvement.falsifier: First weekly firing due Saturday 2026-08-29. NO board line by end of Saturday + grace => the schedule exists but the body does not execute (paste/frontmatter class — the brief-editor signature) => alarm fires and the body needs inspection. A line on any non-Saturday => roster wrong again, re-measure.

_default.falsifier: two consecutive silent days for a task carrying no explicit entry here.

_contested_note: A 'contested' source means two readings disagree and the entry is set to whichever one KEEPS THE ALARM ON until an observation settles it.
